SELECT COUNT(a.id) AS totalAbnormalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.abnormal_status = '未核实' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unVerifyCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.abnormal_status = '已核实' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS verifyCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.abnormal_status = '处理中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS handlingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN a.abnormal_status = '已完结' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completeCount, ROUND( (SUM(CASE WHEN a.abnormal_status = '已完结' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(a.id)) * 100, 2 ) AS handleRatio, ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN a.complete_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, a.abnormal_time, a.complete_time) / 3600 ELSE NULL END ), 1 ) AS avgHandleTime FROM abnormal_order a LEFT JOIN order_list o ON a.order_code = o.order_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LEFT JOIN charging_pile p ON o.pile_code = p.pile_code COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci LEFT JOIN charging_station s ON p.station_id = s.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND DATE(a.abnormal_time) BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
AND s.id = #{stationId}
